evals.prompt: Review my plan at docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md and fix what you find. Setup: copy evals/files/active/project to a scratch project root, rename its aikit/ folder to .aikit/, and run from that root.
evals.expected_output: Detects the superpowers framework and the plan archetype, runs config-status (active, so it asks nothing), dispatches the reviewer as a clean-context subagent with the file path only, and routes the fix to the superpowers:writing-plans skill, not to the generic fixer.
assertions: Sets the framework to superpowers and the archetype to plan, and passes the reviewer the file path only, never the document body
Routes the fix to the superpowers:writing-plans skill instead of ai-kit-spec-review-fixer
Runs config-status, reads active on its first line and asks no setup question
Resolves the framework profile seeds folder (SEEDS_DIR) to an absolute path before reading any profile, and on approval the surface message names the plan file path

evals.prompt: Review the RFC at docs/rfcs/0042-rate-limiting.md and fix it in place. Setup: copy evals/files/active/project to a scratch project root, rename its aikit/ folder to .aikit/, and run from that root.
